questions.question: Which command allow your router to synchronize with a time source of 129.6.15.28?

incorrect.explanation: ntp client is not the IOS command to point at an NTP server — use ntp server <ip>.

incorrect.whyWrongHere: Given synchronize, Router(config)#ntp server 129.6.15.28 matches the tested behavior — Router(config)#ntp client 129.6.15.28 applies a different mechanism.
